faqs.q: What is the annual fee for AU Ananta Credit Card?
faqs.a: AU Ananta Credit Card charges a joining fee of Rs. 2,000 + applicable taxes and an annual fee of Rs. 2,000 + applicable taxes. The annual fee can be waived on spending Rs. 3 Lakh in a year.

faqs.q: What reward rate does AU Ananta Credit Card offer?
faqs.a: The card offers 5 Reward Points per Rs. 100 spent on shopping, dining, and travel, 2 Reward Points per Rs. 100 on other eligible spends, and 1 Reward Point per Rs. 100 on insurance, utility, and telecom spends.

faqs.q: Does AU Ananta Credit Card offer lounge access?
faqs.a: Yes, the card offers 4 complimentary airport lounge visits per quarter on booking flight tickets worth Rs. 5,000 or more through AU Rewardz.

faqs.q: Can I get milestone benefits on AU Ananta Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes, cardholders can earn up to 50,000 bonus Reward Points annually on achieving spending milestones of up to Rs. 10 Lakh in a year.

faqs.q: Is AU Ananta Credit Card good for travel benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, frequent travellers can benefit from accelerated rewards, hotel booking discounts via AU Rewardz, complimentary lounge access, and travel-related insurance coverage.

faqs.q: Who should choose AU Ananta Credit Card?
faqs.a: This card is suitable for consumers who frequently shop online, dine out, and travel regularly, especially those who prefer to make bookings through AU Rewardz and District to maximize benefits.
